headline: Euro Zone Bond Yields Rise as Global Stocks Rebound
summary: Euro zone bond yields climbed as a recovery in global stock markets and rising oil prices prompted investors to dial back demand for safe-haven assets.
why: European government bond yields act as the risk-free benchmark for borrowing costs across the euro zone economy.

impacts.name: Euro zone bond yields
impacts.why: A shift away from safe-haven assets reduces bond demand, driving yields higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A recovery in global stock markets and higher oil prices reduced the safe-haven appeal of government debt, causing bond yields to climb after four straight sessions of declines.
